text:
taylor: Quick design review — private setup wizard handoff / callout states. Focusing on the network prereqs step. TL;DR: make the next-step guidance clearer for infra engineers, improve aria behavior, and reduce 'why blocked' confusion.

sam: Agree. Main pain is the `Start checks` CTA disappearing when errors show. Suggest we keep primary disabled but add an inline 'why' callout and remediation links.

arya: Copy nit: instead of 'Run network checks' can we say 'Check connectivity to Redwood endpoints'? More actionable for customers.

 taylor: Good call. Also propose a tiny inline accordion under each failed check with: 1) one-line explanation 2) short remediation 3) a `curl` example people can copy.

 sam: Example `curl` we can show: ```curl -v https://connect.redwood.ai/health -H 'Host: <your-hostname>'``` — keeps it practical.

 anjali: @taylor re: a11y — aria-live region for status updates, focus management for modal dialogs, and ensure error banners use `role=alert`. Also double-check tab order: primary CTA should be reachable after help links so keyboard users get context.

 lucy: QA note: add a keyboard-only flow case + VoiceOver readthrough to the plan. I can own that.

 taylor: Copy proposal for failed CIDR: 'We couldn't verify the CIDR range. Confirm your VPC routing allows outbound traffic to 10.XX.XX.XX/8 and that NAT is configured.' Thoughts?

 sam: For external-facing docs we should avoid too much raw CIDR jargon. For enterprise infra teams it's fine, but product managers might get lost. Suggest two-mode copy: 'Guided' (plain language) and 'Advanced' (technical details).

 arya: I like that — default to 'Guided' with an 'Expert details' expander. Use 'Why this matters' microcopy to explain the impact.

 lucy: Design detail: use inline status chips (green/amber/red) with icons and short text labels, don't rely on color alone. Confirm contrast passes.

 taylor: :eyes: We'll add icons and high-contrast outlines. No color-only signals.

 design-bot: Auto-note — updated Figma frames at /figma/private-wizard/hand-off-callout v3.

 anjali: Also make sure 'Skip for now' is never the primary action and that skipping surfaces an explicit consent + telemetry disclosure banner.

 sam: From infra side: surface the exact failing host:port and a copyable details panel so SREs can run quick checks.

 taylor: UX pattern: show hostname and a 'Show details' chevron. Details open into a copyable panel with logs / failing check output. Keep it collapsed by default.

 arya: Copy tweak for success state: 'All checks passed — your private deployment is ready to continue.' Short and confident.

 lucy: I'll draft accessibility test steps and sample screen-reader text. Assigning to @anjali and @taylor for review.

 taylor: Action items: I'll update Figma and copy; @sam please add the concrete `curl` examples and the panel payload; @lucy add QA cases. Reconvene Friday 11:00am PT to sign off. :calendar:

 sam: Sounds good.

 anjali: On it.

 lucy: Adding test checklist to the ticket — will ping once ready.

 taylor: Thanks all — this iteration should reduce support tickets and speed up private deploys.
